name: Chouryou Bun'en
source: A general of the Tou army. She has a hatred of cheating and relishes fair fights with strong opponents. Despite her daredevil nature, she is actually a good general who deeply cares for her soldiers in addition to having great awareness on the battlefield. She has a strong obsession of [url=/c217]Kan'u[/url] to the point of even modeling her own weapon as a black version of the Green Dragon Crescent Blade.
